lcc_original: 地上還沒有草木【2】，田野的菜蔬還沒有長起來，因爲永恆主上帝還沒有降雨在地上，也沒有人耕種土地；
notes: First-clause H07704 (שָׂדֶה, UNV 野地 'of the field') has no LCC correspondent: LCC restructures the clause as 地上 ('on the earth') without a 'field' qualifier for shrubs. H07704 for the herbs clause maps normally to 田野.

{<WH0776>} was implicit in UNV (בָאָרֶץ) but LCC makes it explicit as 地上 at clause-initial position → braces dropped per rule 3. {<WAH09002>} (waw conjunction, וְכֹל) remains implicit at clause start.

First 還沒有 split as 還沒<WH02962>有<WAH01961><WTH8799> following UNV split (טֶרֶם + הָיָה); second 還沒有<WH02962> stays together (טֶרֶם only, no הָיָה); third 還沒有<WH03808> maps to לֹא (different Hebrew word).
耶和華+神 (UNV) → 永恆主<WH03068>上帝<WH0430> (standard LCC rendering for YHWH + Elohim).
耕種 (LCC, two-char) covers UNV's 耕 (single char); all three tags WAH09001+WH05647+WTH8800 attached to 耕種. 土地 (LCC) covers UNV's 地, H0127 attached to 土地.
